subject: Observability add-on pricing: flexible retention credits & metric-level SLAs
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearsky.ai>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability addons — retention & tracing pricing questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the tracing and metrics dashboards look promising. To move toward procurement we need a clearer picture of how Redwood prices the observability add-ons (retention, tracing ingest, and advanced dashboards). Two specifics: 1) we’d like a model that lets us keep 90 days of high-resolution traces for a subset of services and 365-day aggregated metrics for everything else, and 2) any crediting or upfront commitment that would offset the first-year costs.

Could you share a short SOW-level price sketch plus any discount bands available for a 12–18 month committed path? We’re trying to present a narrow set of options to our finance team next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearSky Analytics

Attachment: (none)
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Hi Maria — great to hear from you. High level answers below; I attached a short SKU sheet (observability-sku-proposal.xlsx) and a starter SOW (SOW-draft-v2.pdf) for your procurement team.

Quick sketch (ballpark):
- Tracing ingest (high-res): $0.045/trace-unit, with tiered discounts by volume (10% at $25k/month, 20% at $60k/month).
- Metrics (long-term aggregated): $0.008/metric-GB/month for 365d aggregated storage.
- Dashboards (advanced): $1,200/month per seat for unlimited saved queries and alerting; seatless read-only dashboards are available at $350/month.Hybrid seatless model to lower cost if you want broad access.

Crediting / commitment options we propose:
- 1-year commit (12 months): standard 15% commit credit applied against add-ons.
- 18-month commit / $300k+ ARR: up to 30% credit on observability add-ons (front-loaded as year-1 credit). Credits can be consumed against up to three SKU categories (traces, metrics, dashboards).
- Trial clause: first 30 days free for up to 200k trace-units to validate retention shape.

Tradeoffs to consider: if you insist on 90d high-res for a subset of services we recommend policy-based retention (pin only critical service prefixes) + lightweight prefix caching — reduces effective ingest by ~40% in typical workloads. Karthik can sketch the data flow and a sample cost calc if that would help.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Karthik and our commercial manager (Lauren) to see nominal pricing bands and formal discount authority. If procurement needs a PO path we can surface the SOW and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Maria

Maria — looping Lauren (commercial) and Karthik (solutions) to address the two procurement points and the implementation credit ask. Responses inline below: 

- Cross-environment crediting: Yes — credits are attachable to the account level and can be consumed across Hosted and Dedicated model usage under the same billing entity. We’ll include a clause in the SOW to guarantee credit portability if you migrate workloads within 12 months.

- Overage billing: Monthly metered true-up with 30-day invoice terms is our default. For commits above $250k/year we offer quarterly reconciliations and a capped overage rate (we can set a 10% cap on monthly overage for the first 6 months to provide runway).

- Implementation/onboarding credit: Lauren — can you confirm commercial approval? Our ask: for a $350k+ 18-month committed path we can offer a one-time 25% implementation credit applied to year-1 add-ons, provided the contract is signed within 30 days of this SOW. This would be in lieu of additional percent discount on unit pricing.

Karthik — can you attach a short example calc (3-service sample) showing the effective delta between policy-based pinning vs full high-res retention? Customer wants to see real numbers.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call with procurement to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Vanessa
